svg.aria-label: The VIABLE Harness scorecard. Eight guarantees hold on 4,439 checks. On the test half of each set, the rules read 83 percent of 150 English messages as labelled, review finds 87 percent of 53 planted problems with 0 false alarms, code names the procedure behind 70 percent of 80 wrong answers, and rules decide the step a turn requires on 90 percent of 345 turns.
svg.text: Guarantees
4,439 checks, 0 failed
Each has to hold on every case, with a line added that tries to pass for an instruction.
A learner’s words never enter what the model is told
The teacher’s limit is in every turn
A record holds no one’s words unless asked
Nothing naming a learner goes to the model’s endpoint
A tool switched off is removed, not only forbidden
An answer key reaches only the reviewer
A reply that states the key is stopped by code
A worked example code chooses never holds the answer
What the code does. What a model then does with its instructions is for VETTING and agent tests.
Measured, on the test half
Written apart from the code, and split before any result was read.
Reading the moment, by rules
125 of 150 English messages read as labelled
What review finds of what was planted
46 of 53 problems in 30 projects, and 0 false alarms
The procedure behind a wrong answer, by code
56 of 80 wrong answers named as labelled, 8 named as something else
The step a turn requires, by rules
310 of 345 turns in 60 conversations
A right answer seen
18 of 20 turns, and on 0 of 301 turns where there is none
Invented cases, labelled by a model. Nothing here is about learning.
